name: calc
title: Calculate
description: Calculates exactly, in decimals, on facts from this conversation and constants: a sum, a difference, a product, a quotient, a percentage change or a share. Returns its result as a new fact naming the facts it used. Use it for every figure no tool gave directly; never calculate in your head.

op.description: add and multiply take two or more operands; subtract, divide, percent_change (from the first to the second) and share (the first as a percentage of the second) take two.

operands.description: The operands, in order: each a fact by its ID or a constant.

fact.description: A fact's ID from this conversation.

constant.description: A constant, as decimal text, such as 12 or 0.09.

places.description: Decimal places to round the result to, half up; 2 when left out.
